# Update component kind dispatch

The card updater's dispatch on component kind.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60ce6aa5` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

The official 1.1 file has USR 0x100, OSD 0x101, RESCOM 0x106, LUKE 0x10e and PIC 0x102; no BOOT or sub-CPU kind, so it does not rewrite boot code. No version gate was found.
